newsitem.title: USA: GM sees Q3 North America output up 4.2 pct.
newsitem.headline: GM sees Q3 North America output up 4.2 pct.

text.p: General Motors Corp said Friday it expects to make 1,311,000 cars and trucks in North America in the 1997 third quarter, a 4.2 percent increase over the 1,258,000 vehicles produced in the 1996 third quarter.
The estimate includes 716,000 passenger cars and 595,000 trucks, versus 718,000 and 540,000, respectively, a year ago.
GM cut its second quarter production estimate by 46,000 vehicles, to 1,477,000, reflecting lower output in May because of labor strikes at plants in Oklahoma City and Pontiac, Mich.
In the 1996 second quarter GM produced 1,549,000 vehicles.
GM said that in May it made 266,000 cars and 207,000 trucks in North America, for a total of 473,000 vehicles. In May 1996 it made 310,000 cars and 229,000 trucks, for a total of 539,000 vehicles.
